title: Google Docs
description: Exposes Google Docs operations as agent tools.
Read a document's text; create documents; append and replace text;
insert images and tables; and run arbitrary batchUpdate requests
Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

access.title: Access level
description: Docs scopes to request. readonly: read document text and metadata only. write: full read/write (create
documents, append and replace text, insert images and tables, and run arbitrary batchUpdate requests).
